checks.observation: The inherited source explicitly proves support at most 85 for an intersecting 28-member rank-four family and supplies the finite-obstruction equivalence. The boundary module separately states unrestricted_eighty_of_three_open_inputs with I(27), nonrealizability of Profile A, and nonrealizability of Profile B as premises. Thus improving support capacity does not discharge those three inputs or yield an unconditional bound 80. This source inspection does not authenticate retained objects or independently reproduce the external literature enumeration.
